Subject: Quarter kickoff — goal playbook endorsement & owner clarifications

Team —

Attached is the Q3 Goal Playbook v1 (spreadsheet + short notes). This consolidates the proposed objectives and candidate key results for the quarter across Platform, Serving Runtime, and DevEx. High-level asks:

- Please review the measurement definitions in the "Metrics" tab and flag anything that will be hard to instrument by week 2.
- Confirm owner assignments on rows highlighted in yellow (these are tentative).
- Endorse the playbook so we can publish to the cross-functional kickoff doc and start rolling to CS/Customer Success for impacted pilots (see related HubSpot deal CRM-4391).

Known blockers I want visibility on: procurement approval timelines for Dedicated capacity pilots (Nimbus Health), and three rollout dependencies on the Optimize team quantization experiments. I've called these out in the "Risks & Mitigations" appendix.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Owners finalize measurement definitions by EOD Tuesday (02-Jun).
2) We hold a 30m owner alignment sync on Wednesday to confirm instrumentation and handoffs.
3) With your sign-off, Grace, we route the finalized playbook to Procurement + Legal and schedule the customer kickoff.

Meeting: I've tentatively set the owner sync for Wed 10:00-10:30 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Attachments: Q3_goal_playbook_v1.xlsx, owner-rollforward-notes.pdf

Thanks —
Logan
